enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt is generated on a synchronization error.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt is generated if the embedded synchronization codes are not received in the correct order and the ERR_IE bit in DCMI_IER is set.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt is generated on each DCMI_VSYNC transition from the inactive to the active state and the VSYNC_IE bit is set in DCMI_IER.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt generation when the line is received

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: An Interrupt is generated when a line has been completely received and the LINE_IE bit is set in DCMI_IER.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x3

enumeratedValue.description: Only ECDSA verification (MODE = 0x26) is supported by the PKA.

enumeratedValue.description: Access to PKA RAM and programming of PKA_CR has no extra limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: PKA RAM is write-only until START is set (it is no access then), and the MODE value written in PKA_CR must correspond to the CCOP mode selected in the CCB peripheral.

enumeratedValue.description: Random number not OK (if applicable).

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x2

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x3

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x5
enumeratedValue.description: Gated mode - The counter clock is enabled when the trigger input (tim_trgi) is high.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x6
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger mode - The counter starts at a rising edge of the trigger tim_trgi (but it is not reset).

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x7
enumeratedValue.description: External Clock mode 1 - Rising edges of the selected trigger (tim_trgi) clock the counter.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave mode disabled - if CEN = 1 then the prescaler is clocked directly by the internal clock.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: Encoder mode 1 - Counter counts up/down on tim_ti1fp1 edge depending on tim_ti2fp2 level.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x2
enumeratedValue.description: Encoder mode 2 - Counter counts up/down on tim_ti2fp2 edge depending on tim_ti1fp1 level.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x3
enumeratedValue.description: Encoder mode 3 - Counter counts up/down on both tim_ti1fp1 and tim_ti2fp2 edges depending on the level of the other input.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x4
enumeratedValue.description: Reset mode - Rising edge of the selected trigger input (tim_trgi) reinitializes the counter and generates an update of the registers.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x5
enumeratedValue.description: Gated mode - The counter clock is enabled when the trigger input (tim_trgi) is high.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x6
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger mode - The counter starts at a rising edge of the trigger tim_trgi (but it is not reset).

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x7
enumeratedValue.description: External clock mode 1 - Rising edges of the selected trigger (tim_trgi) clock the counter.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0
enumeratedValue.description: LOCK OFF - No bit is write protected.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: LOCK Level 1 = DTG bits in TIMx_BDTR register, OISx and OISxN bits in TIMx_CR2 register and BKBID/BK2BID/BKE/BKP/AOE bits in TIMx_BDTR register can no longer be written.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x2
enumeratedValue.description: LOCK Level 2 = LOCK Level 1 + CC Polarity bits (CCxP/CCxNP bits in TIMx_CCER register, as long as the related channel is configured in output through the CCxS bits) as well as OSSR and OSSI bits can no longer be written.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x3
enumeratedValue.description: LOCK Level 3 = LOCK Level 2 + CC Control bits (OCxM and OCxPE bits in TIMx_CCMRx registers, as long as the related channel is configured in output through the CCxS bits) can no longer be written.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: When inactive, OC/OCN outputs are first forced with their inactive level then forced to their idle level after the deadtime.

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x0
enumeratedValue.description: When inactive, OC/OCN outputs are disabled (the timer releases the output control which is taken over by the GPIO logic, which forces a Hi-Z state).

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x1

enumeratedValue.name: B_0x5
